title: Why play mahjong online — and which game is right for you?
intro: Mahjong is one of the easiest ways to clear your head for a few minutes — and one of the most satisfying to actually learn. Here’s why people keep coming back, and a quick way to find the game that fits your mood.

bullets.strong: It’s a real break, not a time sink.
bullets.text: No downloads, no account to start — open a board and clear your head. →

bullets.strong: There’s a version for every mood.
bullets.text: Want pure calm? Match tiles in solitaire. Want a real game of skill? Sit at a four-player table against the bots. →

bullets.strong: You can actually get good at it.
bullets.text: Our beginner guides walk you through the tiles, the rules and a winning hand in plain language — no jargon walls. →
